messages:
Dana: Thanks for joining the all-hands follow-up thread for reliability. Posting action items and the RCA link.
Dana: RCA: https://docs.redwood.ai/rca/2026-03-incident-237. TL;DR and action list at the top.
Mohan: Quick q — are items prioritized? I see several candidates.
Dana: Yes, we've annotated P0/P1 in the doc. P0 = router misroute fallback. P1 = obs gaps and autoscaler tuning.
Elena: Who's shipping the hotfix for P0? Need to align traces.
Priya: Runtime owns hotfix (Rory). Infra will apply a temporary routing override until validated.
Rory: Confirm. Target patch: 03/24 10:00 PT. Will post PR link here after tests.
Sam: For support, what's the exact SLO window impacted? Need that for comms.
incident-bot: incident-237 posted -> https://incidents.redwood.ai/237
Mohan: Suggest one consolidated customer email + status-page update. Claire, can you take this?
Claire: Yes. I'll draft both and share here for review by 11:30 PT.
Priya: Observability gap: missing token-level breakdown for fallback region. Elena, can you own RED-7123?
Elena: Took RED-7123, attached traces and sample queries. Will add a dev checklist.
Dana: Actions: 1) Runtime hotfix (Rory) target 03/24 10:00 PT. 2) Routing override removal plan (Infra/Priya) target 03/24 12:00 PT. 3) RED-7123 triage (Elena) EOD. 4) Customer comms (Claire) draft 11:30 PT. 5) Post-deploy verification (Mohan+Sam) 30m signoff.
Mohan: Smoke command: ./scripts/smoke-check --model gpt-redwood-v1 --concurrency 5 + token-diff.
Rory: Will open PR and link in the RCA once CI/pass.
Sam: After PR, I'll run the smoke script and 15-min soak on staging, then canary if OK.
Priya: If routing override >12h we need a maintenance window. Ops prefers <12h.
Dana: Aim for <12h; escalate if patch slips.
Elena: Request snapshot of sequence-length distribution during event. Added sampling hooks in RED-7123.
Mohan: I'll export and attach distribution to RED-7123 by 09:00 PT.
Claire: Drafts incoming ~45m, will ping for approvals.
Dana: Please mark RCA checklist items you own. If you can't meet targets, flag now.
Rory: ACK, will update RCA and add PR.
Priya: ACK, will paste rollback playbook steps into the doc.
Sam: I'll post soak results in this thread after running checks.
Mohan: I'll monitor p50/p95/p99 and post snapshots.
Dana: I'll summarize at 11:45 PT and close this follow-up thread unless objections.
Elena: No objections. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Reminder: status page update due in 1 hour for incident-237.
Claire: Draft posted -> https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/237-draft
Dana: Thanks — keep updates concise here.
